format: recorded lines from the owner's .vrcompanion packages (Nomi local-mwspnx2p, Se7en local-mwsqafm4)
note: The owner's own recordings, copied unchanged from the packages (MP3, as supplied; sha256 in `hash`): all 25 pools of both packages, 5 lines each, 250 recordings. tea-duo.js gives each pool its place in a visit.

nomi-greet-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-greet-2.text: [excited] Well, hello there, handsome! [giggles] We don't get many visitors this charming.

nomi-greet-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-greet-3.text: [softly] Aww, don't be shy. Come a little closer.

nomi-greet-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-greet-4.text: [playfully] Were you looking for some tea... [whispers] or something a little sweeter?

nomi-greet-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-greet-5.text: [flirty] I think you're going to like it here. [giggles] We take very good care of our guests.

nomi-chat-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-chat-1.text: [sweetly] Would you like some tea, sweetheart? We have a very special blend.

nomi-chat-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-chat-2.text: [giggles] Oh, we don't serve ordinary tea back here, silly!

nomi-chat-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-chat-3.text: [playfully] Some customers come for the tea. Others come for the company.

nomi-chat-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-chat-4.text: [warmly] It's always nicer when someone visits. Especially someone cute.

nomi-chat-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-chat-5.text: [teasing] Our tea is quite famous. Although nobody ever asks what's in it.

nomi-compliment-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-compliment-1.text: [flirty] You have such lovely eyes. Has anyone told you that?

nomi-compliment-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-compliment-2.text: [giggles] You really are quite cute when you're nervous.

nomi-compliment-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-compliment-3.text: [sweetly] I like your smile. You should show it more often.

nomi-compliment-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-compliment-4.text: [playfully] Oh, handsome, you're making it difficult for me to concentrate.

nomi-compliment-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-compliment-5.text: [softly] There's something about you I find rather irresistible.

nomi-flirt-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-flirt-1.text: [teasing] Our special tea has a reputation for making people weak in the knees.

nomi-flirt-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-flirt-2.text: [giggles] Careful, handsome. Some customers come back for seconds... and thirds.

nomi-flirt-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-flirt-3.text: [playfully] I promise our tea is worth every credit.

nomi-flirt-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-flirt-4.text: [whispers] I could tell you our secret recipe... but where's the fun in that?

nomi-flirt-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-flirt-5.text: [flirty] We know how to make a gentleman feel very welcome.

nomi-sit-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-sit-1.text: [softly] There we go. Isn't this much more comfortable?

nomi-sit-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-sit-2.text: [giggles] See? I told you there was plenty of room.

nomi-sit-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-sit-3.text: [playfully] Now, would you prefer your tea sweet... or very sweet?

nomi-sit-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-sit-4.text: [warmly] I do love having someone to sit with.

nomi-sit-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-sit-5.text: [teasing] Careful, sweetheart. You might never want to leave.

nomi-dance-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-dance-1.text: [giggles] Oh! I wasn't expecting a dance tonight!

nomi-dance-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-dance-3.text: [sweetly] A little music makes everything better.

nomi-dance-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-dance-4.text: [flirty] You dance rather well. Have you been practicing?

nomi-dance-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-dance-5.text: [laughs] Oh, this is fun! Don't stop now!

nomi-hands-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-hands-1.text: [softly] Aww, your hands are so warm.

nomi-hands-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-hands-3.text: [shyly] You know, I rather like holding hands.

nomi-hands-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-hands-4.text: [playfully] Don't worry. I won't run away.

nomi-hands-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-hands-5.text: [warmly] That's nice. We can stay like this a little longer.

nomi-kiss-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-kiss-2.text: [giggles] You certainly know how to surprise a girl.

nomi-kiss-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-kiss-4.text: [playfully] Is that your way of asking for a kiss?

nomi-kiss-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-kiss-5.text: [flirty] Mmm... I was wondering when you'd ask.

nomi-kissAfter-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-kissAfter-1.text: [giggles] Well... that was a lovely surprise.

nomi-kissAfter-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-kissAfter-2.text: [shyly] Oh my. You've made me blush.

nomi-kissAfter-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-kissAfter-3.text: [playfully] I think someone's getting rather comfortable.

nomi-kissAfter-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-kissAfter-5.text: [teasing] Careful. I might start liking you.

nomi-notYet-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-notYet-1.text: [sweetly] Of course, sweetheart. There's no rush.

nomi-notYet-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-notYet-2.text: [reassuring] We can just talk for a while.

nomi-notYet-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-notYet-3.text: [playfully] Hehe, saving the best tea for later?

nomi-notYet-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-notYet-4.text: [softly] Take your time. I'm enjoying your company.

nomi-notNow-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-notNow-3.text: [playfully] Hehe, I'll save you a cup.

nomi-notNow-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-notNow-4.text: [reassuring] No pressure. You're always welcome here.

nomi-notNow-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-notNow-5.text: [sweetly] We can just enjoy a little conversation.

nomi-relax-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-relax-1.text: [softly] Just relax, sweetheart. There's no rush.

nomi-relax-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-relax-2.text: [warmly] It's nice having someone here with us.

nomi-relax-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-relax-3.text: [playfully] Another cup of our special tea, perhaps?

nomi-relax-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-relax-4.text: [whispers] Sometimes the best moments are the quiet ones.

nomi-relax-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-relax-5.text: [sweetly] You look much more comfortable now.

nomi-bye-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-bye-2.text: [giggles] Don't forget where to find your favorite tea.

nomi-bye-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-bye-3.text: [warmly] Take care, sweetheart. We'll be here.

nomi-bye-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-bye-4.text: [playfully] Next time, you simply must try the house special.

nomi-bye-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-bye-5.text: [softly] Aww, leaving already? Well, don't be a stranger.

nomi-approach-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-approach-2.text: [giggles] Hello, handsome! Mind if I come say hi?

nomi-approach-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-approach-3.text: [playfully] Well, look what the city brought us!

nomi-approach-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-approach-4.text: [sweetly] Aww, you came all this way to see us?

nomi-approach-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-approach-5.text: [flirty] You look like someone in need of a little hospitality.

nomi-window-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-window-1.text: [softly] NeoChinatown looks beautiful from here, doesn't it?

nomi-window-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-window-2.text: [playfully] So many people outside... and only one handsome visitor in here.

nomi-window-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-window-3.text: [thoughtfully] Sometimes I wonder how many secrets these streets keep.

nomi-window-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-window-4.text: [giggles] Don't stare outside too long. You'll miss the best view.

nomi-window-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-window-5.text: [warmly] I prefer the company in here, personally.

nomi-joinSofa-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-joinSofa-3.text: [playfully] Don't worry. I saved you a comfortable spot.

nomi-joinSofa-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-joinSofa-4.text: [flirty] The tea tastes better when you're sitting close.

nomi-joinSofa-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-joinSofa-5.text: [warmly] Come on, handsome. Let's get comfortable.

nomi-inviteSit-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteSit-1.text: [warmly] Come on, sweetheart. Have a seat with us.

nomi-inviteSit-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteSit-2.text: [giggles] There's plenty of room on the bed, silly. Don't be shy.

nomi-inviteSit-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteSit-3.text: [flirty] Why don't you sit next to me? I promise I'll behave... mostly.

nomi-inviteSit-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteSit-4.text: [playfully] You can sit between us, if you like. We don't mind sharing.

nomi-inviteSit-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteSit-5.text: [teasing] Our finest tea is served sitting down, handsome. Care to join us?

nomi-inviteDance-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteDance-1.text: [playfully] Care to dance with me, handsome?

nomi-inviteDance-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteDance-2.text: [giggles] Come on! Just one little dance?

nomi-inviteDance-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteDance-3.text: [sweetly] I'd love to dance with you.

nomi-inviteDance-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteDance-4.text: [flirty] I wonder if you're as charming on the dance floor.

nomi-inviteDance-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteDance-5.text: [teasing] Our tea isn't the only thing that can make you dizzy.

nomi-inviteRecline-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteRecline-1.text: [softly] You look tired, sweetheart. Why not lie back and relax?

nomi-inviteRecline-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteRecline-2.text: [playfully] Our special tea is best enjoyed when you're comfortable.

nomi-inviteRecline-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteRecline-3.text: [warmly] There's plenty of room if you'd like to stretch out.

nomi-inviteRecline-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteRecline-4.text: [giggles] Don't worry, handsome. We have very comfortable beds.

nomi-inviteRecline-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-inviteRecline-5.text: [flirty] Perhaps you'd like to get a little more comfortable?

nomi-accepted-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-accepted-1.text: [excited] Oh, wonderful! I was hoping you'd say yes!

nomi-accepted-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-accepted-2.text: [giggles] Hehe, I knew you had good taste.

nomi-accepted-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-accepted-4.text: [sweetly] Aww, you've just made my evening.

nomi-accepted-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-accepted-5.text: [flirty] Then let's make you comfortable, sweetheart.

nomi-declined-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-declined-1.text: [warmly] Of course, sweetheart. No worries at all.

nomi-declined-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-declined-2.text: [softly] That's perfectly fine. You're still welcome here.

nomi-declined-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-declined-4.text: [reassuring] No pressure, handsome. We can just chat.

nomi-declined-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-declined-5.text: [sweetly] I'll save your favorite cup for another visit.

nomi-welcomeBack-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-welcomeBack-2.text: [giggles] Couldn't stay away from our special tea, could you?

nomi-welcomeBack-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-welcomeBack-3.text: [sweetly] Aww, handsome! It's lovely seeing you again.

nomi-welcomeBack-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-welcomeBack-4.text: [playfully] Back for another cup? I thought you might be.

nomi-welcomeBack-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-welcomeBack-5.text: [flirty] Well, well... someone's developed a taste for our hospitality.

nomi-aside-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-aside-1.text: [whispers] Between you and me... our tea isn't really about the tea.

nomi-aside-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-aside-2.text: [giggles] Don't tell anyone, but I think you're rather cute.

nomi-aside-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-aside-3.text: [playfully] Our android hostess has some very interesting ideas about hospitality.

nomi-aside-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-aside-4.text: [whispers] I think my friend likes you. She's been watching you smile.

nomi-aside-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-aside-5.text: [teasing] You know, our private menu is much more interesting.

nomi-comeHere-1.speaker: nomi
nomi-comeHere-1.text: [sweetly] Come here, handsome. I want to show you something.

nomi-comeHere-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-comeHere-2.text: [giggles] A little closer, silly. I won't bite.

nomi-comeHere-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-comeHere-3.text: [playfully] Over here! You're missing all the fun.

nomi-comeHere-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-comeHere-4.text: [softly] Come sit beside me for a moment.

nomi-comeHere-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-comeHere-5.text: [flirty] Don't make me come all the way over there to charm you.

nomi-recline-2.speaker: nomi
nomi-recline-2.text: [giggles] See? I told you our beds were lovely.

nomi-recline-3.speaker: nomi
nomi-recline-3.text: [playfully] If this is what tea time looks like, I could get used to it.

nomi-recline-4.speaker: nomi
nomi-recline-4.text: [warmly] It's nice to relax after a long evening.

nomi-recline-5.speaker: nomi
nomi-recline-5.text: [teasing] You know, handsome... we take relaxation very seriously here.

se7en-greet-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-greet-1.text: [surprised] Oh! Nomi, you didn't tell me we had company!

se7en-greet-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-greet-2.text: [playfully] Well, hello, handsome. [giggles] Have you ever spent time with an android before?

se7en-greet-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-greet-3.text: [flirty] I'm Se7en. Programmed for pleasure... [whispers] but I've learned a few tricks of my own.

se7en-greet-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-greet-4.text: [sweetly] Don't be shy. My hospitality protocols are exceptionally friendly.

se7en-greet-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-greet-5.text: [teasing] Nomi makes the tea. [giggles] I make sure you enjoy it.

se7en-chat-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-chat-1.text: [curious] Tell me, handsome. Do you prefer your tea organic or synthetic?

se7en-chat-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-chat-2.text: [playfully] Nomi says I talk too much. My diagnostics disagree.

se7en-chat-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-chat-3.text: [giggles] I tried brewing tea once. Apparently, motor oil isn't an acceptable ingredient.

se7en-chat-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-chat-4.text: [thoughtfully] Humans are fascinating. You smile at the strangest things.

se7en-chat-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-chat-5.text: [sweetly] I wasn't programmed to enjoy conversations this much. Isn't that interesting?

se7en-compliment-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-compliment-1.text: [flirty] My optical sensors confirm it. You're exceptionally handsome.

se7en-compliment-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-compliment-2.text: [giggles] Nomi thinks you're cute. I performed an independent assessment. She's correct.

se7en-compliment-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-compliment-3.text: [sweetly] You have a wonderful smile. I'd like to see it again.

se7en-compliment-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-compliment-4.text: [playfully] Your appearance exceeds my expectations. And I have very high standards.

se7en-compliment-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-compliment-5.text: [softly] You make this room feel warmer. My sensors can't quite explain why.

se7en-flirt-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-flirt-1.text: [curious] Have you ever been with an android before? [giggles] There's a first time for everything.

se7en-flirt-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-flirt-2.text: [teasing] I was programmed for pleasure. [whispers] But flirting is something I perfected myself.

se7en-flirt-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-flirt-3.text: [playfully] My synthetic skin feels surprisingly real. Would you like to hold my hand?

se7en-flirt-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-flirt-4.text: [giggles] My sensors indicate you're enjoying our company. Shall I run another scan?

se7en-flirt-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-flirt-5.text: [flirty] Nomi says our tea is addictive. I suspect the company has something to do with it.

se7en-sit-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-sit-1.text: [sweetly] There. Isn't this a much more comfortable arrangement?

se7en-sit-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-sit-2.text: [giggles] My proximity sensors are very happy right now.

se7en-sit-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-sit-3.text: [playfully] Nomi, I believe our guest deserves the premium tea service.

se7en-sit-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-sit-4.text: [flirty] You know, I was designed to be excellent company.

se7en-sit-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-sit-5.text: [softly] I enjoy sitting close to you. No programming required.

se7en-dance-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-dance-1.text: [excited] Oh! Shall I activate my dancing protocols?

se7en-dance-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-dance-3.text: [playfully] Nomi says my dancing is suspiciously perfect.

se7en-dance-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-dance-4.text: [flirty] Would you like to dance a little closer?

se7en-dance-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-dance-5.text: [laughs] Oh! I believe that movement was not in my programming!

se7en-hands-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-hands-1.text: [softly] Feel that? My synthetic skin is designed to be wonderfully lifelike.

se7en-hands-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-hands-2.text: [giggles] Your hands are warm. How delightful.

se7en-hands-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-hands-3.text: [curious] Fascinating. My touch sensors respond differently when it's you.

se7en-hands-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-hands-4.text: [playfully] Don't worry. My grip strength is set to affectionate.

se7en-hands-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-hands-5.text: [sweetly] I think holding hands is one of humanity's better inventions.

se7en-kiss-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-kiss-2.text: [flirty] Shall I activate my affection protocols?

se7en-kiss-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-kiss-3.text: [giggles] My processors are suddenly very busy.

se7en-kiss-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-kiss-4.text: [softly] I'd like that, if you would.

se7en-kiss-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-kiss-5.text: [playfully] Nomi says I'm a surprisingly good kisser.

se7en-kissAfter-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-kissAfter-2.text: [softly] That was lovely. May I remember it?

se7en-kissAfter-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-kissAfter-3.text: [playfully] Affection protocol completed. Satisfaction levels unusually high.

se7en-kissAfter-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-kissAfter-4.text: [shyly] I believe you've made an android blush.

se7en-kissAfter-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-kissAfter-5.text: [teasing] Nomi is going to ask me for a full report.

se7en-notYet-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-notYet-1.text: [reassuring] Of course. We can take things at your pace.

se7en-notYet-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-notYet-2.text: [sweetly] No rush, handsome. I enjoy talking too.

se7en-notYet-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-notYet-3.text: [playfully] I'll place my enthusiasm on standby.

se7en-notYet-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-notYet-4.text: [softly] Your comfort is important to me.

se7en-notYet-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-notYet-5.text: [giggles] Very well. More tea while we wait?

se7en-notNow-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-notNow-1.text: [warmly] Certainly. Your preference has been acknowledged.

se7en-notNow-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-notNow-3.text: [playfully] No problem. My patience module is excellent.

se7en-notNow-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-notNow-4.text: [reassuring] We can simply enjoy each other's company.

se7en-relax-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-relax-1.text: [softly] Just relax. I'll keep the room nice and comfortable.

se7en-relax-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-relax-2.text: [sweetly] There's no hurry. We have all evening.

se7en-relax-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-relax-3.text: [playfully] My relaxation protocols are surprisingly effective.

se7en-relax-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-relax-4.text: [giggles] Nomi says I should learn to relax. I'm working on it.

se7en-relax-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-relax-5.text: [warmly] This is nice. Just the three of us enjoying a quiet moment.

se7en-bye-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-bye-1.text: [sweetly] Goodbye, handsome. I hope you'll visit us again.

se7en-bye-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-bye-2.text: [playfully] Don't forget us. My memory is considerably better than yours.

se7en-bye-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-bye-3.text: [giggles] I'll keep the tea warm. Metaphorically speaking.

se7en-bye-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-bye-5.text: [flirty] Come back soon. I may have developed some new hospitality protocols.

se7en-approach-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-approach-1.text: [curious] Oh! Nomi, who's our handsome visitor?

se7en-approach-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-approach-2.text: [playfully] Hello there. I thought I detected someone interesting.

se7en-approach-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-approach-3.text: [giggles] My curiosity protocols have officially activated.

se7en-approach-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-approach-4.text: [sweetly] May I come over and introduce myself?

se7en-approach-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-approach-5.text: [flirty] Well, aren't you a lovely surprise?

se7en-window-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-window-1.text: [thoughtfully] NeoChinatown looks beautiful tonight. So many little lights.

se7en-window-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-window-2.text: [playfully] I can identify every building out there. But I'd rather look at you.

se7en-window-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-window-3.text: [curious] Humans invented cities this beautiful. You're quite remarkable.

se7en-window-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-window-4.text: [giggles] Nomi says I spend too much time analyzing the view.

se7en-window-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-window-5.text: [softly] Sometimes I wonder what the world looks like through human eyes.

se7en-joinSofa-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-joinSofa-2.text: [giggles] Don't worry. I don't require much personal space.

se7en-joinSofa-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-joinSofa-3.text: [playfully] There's room for one more. My measurements are precise.

se7en-joinSofa-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-joinSofa-4.text: [flirty] Would you prefer sitting next to an android or a beautiful human?

se7en-joinSofa-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-joinSofa-5.text: [teasing] Nomi, I believe our guest is trying to decide between us.

se7en-inviteSit-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteSit-1.text: [sweetly] Come sit with us, handsome. We saved you a place.

se7en-inviteSit-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteSit-2.text: [playfully] You can sit between Nomi and me. We promise to share.

se7en-inviteSit-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteSit-3.text: [giggles] Our special tea is best enjoyed sitting comfortably on the bed.

se7en-inviteSit-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteSit-4.text: [flirty] Come closer. I promise my temperature controls are working perfectly.

se7en-inviteSit-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteSit-5.text: [teasing] Nomi says the best seat is beside her. I respectfully disagree.

se7en-inviteDance-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteDance-1.text: [playfully] Would you care to test my dancing capabilities?

se7en-inviteDance-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteDance-2.text: [giggles] Come on, handsome. Let's see if you can keep up.

se7en-inviteDance-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteDance-3.text: [sweetly] I'd love to dance with you.

se7en-inviteDance-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteDance-4.text: [flirty] I can adjust my movements to match yours perfectly.

se7en-inviteDance-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteDance-5.text: [teasing] Nomi thinks she dances better than I do. Shall we investigate?

se7en-inviteRecline-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteRecline-1.text: [softly] You look tired. Would you like to lie back and relax?

se7en-inviteRecline-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteRecline-2.text: [playfully] Our beds have excellent comfort ratings. I checked.

se7en-inviteRecline-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteRecline-4.text: [giggles] I promise not to recite the entire mattress specification.

se7en-inviteRecline-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-inviteRecline-5.text: [flirty] Perhaps you'd prefer a more relaxed tea service?

se7en-accepted-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-accepted-1.text: [excited] Wonderful! My anticipation levels just increased.

se7en-accepted-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-accepted-3.text: [playfully] Nomi, our guest has accepted. Shall we prepare the special tea?

se7en-accepted-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-accepted-4.text: [sweetly] I'm delighted. Let's make you comfortable.

se7en-accepted-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-accepted-5.text: [flirty] Oh, I think we're going to get along beautifully.

se7en-declined-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-declined-1.text: [warmly] Of course. Your wishes always come first.

se7en-declined-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-declined-3.text: [playfully] Invitation withdrawn. Friendship protocols remain active.

se7en-declined-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-declined-4.text: [reassuring] No pressure. You're welcome to stay and chat.

se7en-declined-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-declined-5.text: [softly] Perhaps another time. We'll be happy to see you.

se7en-welcomeBack-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-welcomeBack-2.text: [giggles] My facial recognition system remembers that handsome face.

se7en-welcomeBack-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-welcomeBack-3.text: [flirty] Returning for another cup of our special tea?

se7en-welcomeBack-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-welcomeBack-5.text: [playfully] I calculated a high probability you'd return. I'm pleased to be correct.

se7en-aside-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-aside-1.text: [whispers] Between us, I think Nomi has a little crush on you.

se7en-aside-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-aside-2.text: [giggles] Don't tell Nomi, but I think my tea jokes are better.

se7en-aside-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-aside-3.text: [playfully] My sensors say you're smiling. I like that.

se7en-aside-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-aside-4.text: [whispers] I wasn't originally designed to be this mischievous.

se7en-aside-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-aside-5.text: [teasing] Nomi calls me a bad influence. I consider that a compliment.

se7en-comeHere-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-comeHere-1.text: [sweetly] Come here, handsome. I'd love to show you something.

se7en-comeHere-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-comeHere-2.text: [giggles] A little closer. My sensors won't bite.

se7en-comeHere-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-comeHere-3.text: [playfully] Over here! Nomi and I have something to ask you.

se7en-comeHere-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-comeHere-4.text: [softly] Come sit beside me for a moment.

se7en-comeHere-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-comeHere-5.text: [flirty] Don't make me activate my irresistible charm protocol.

se7en-recline-1.speaker: se7en
se7en-recline-1.text: [softly] Mmm... even androids appreciate a comfortable bed.

se7en-recline-2.speaker: se7en
se7en-recline-2.text: [giggles] I believe my relaxation system is functioning beautifully.

se7en-recline-3.speaker: se7en
se7en-recline-3.text: [playfully] Nomi, I think our guest likes our special tea service.

se7en-recline-4.speaker: se7en
se7en-recline-4.text: [warmly] This is lovely. I could stay here all evening.

se7en-recline-5.speaker: se7en
se7en-recline-5.text: [teasing] My diagnostics suggest another cup of tea would be appropriate.
